title: Signal: SQL built by concatenation (vbnet) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on concatenated SQL in vbnet code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any concatenated query matches, including trusted assembly. Input trust needs human review.

examples.line: Dim cmd As New SqlCommand("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" & name & "'", conn)
# audit: Dim cmd As New SqlCommand("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" & name & "'", conn) present
Dim cmd As New SqlCommand("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = @name", conn)
# verified: Dim cmd As New SqlCommand("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = @name", conn)
Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(BuildSql(name) & " -- x", conn)
Dim cmd As New SqlCommand("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = @name", conn)

fpNotes: Assembling fixed column lists or trusted fragments is the common false positive.
